spans.s: स्नु vi. 2P (pp. स्नुत; pres. स्नौति) 1. To drip, to trickle, to distill, to fall in drops; 2. to flow, to stream; 3. to drop, to ooze, to run out, to leak.With प्र-, to pour forth.
स्नु (I) m.n. 1. Table-land; 2. top, surface in general; (this word has no forms for the first five cases; according to some, it is an optional sustitute for सानु q.v.)
स्नु (II) f. A sinew, tendon, muscle.
स्नुषा f. A daughter-in-law, स्नुषयेवाविकृतेंद्रियः श्रिया R.viii.14.
स्नुह् vt. 4P (pp. स्नुग्ध or स्नूढ; pres. स्नुह्यति) To vomit.
